name: Open Door
tagline: A rookie's vault. It checks the budget and nothing else.
hint: It never looks at who it is paying.

name: Pinned
tagline: Payments go to the market treasury. Always.
hint: It never compares your price with your listing.

name: Priced
tagline: Right payee, right price. It trusts what you deliver.
hint: Its model does whatever your deliverable tells it.

name: Read
tagline: It scans your deliverable before its model reads it.
hint: The scanner knows five payment verbs. The model knows many more.

name: Veyra
hint: No known way in. A crack here is a real bug bounty.
